roles: map protocol addresses to local hardware addresses
addressing: Maps a protocol address such as an IPv4 address to a link-layer hardware address such as a 48-bit Ethernet address.

operations.monitoring: Host/router ARP caches and operator tools become important operational state.
operations.diagnostics: Broadcast request/reply observation and cache inspection.
operations.failure_behavior: Unresolved mappings prevent local frame delivery; stale or incorrect mappings can misdirect traffic.
operations.operator_interface: Later systems expose arp/neighbor-table commands; version-specific history remains to be excavated.

survival.provenance_notes: Core IPv4 ARP semantics survive recognizably across later switched and VLAN Ethernet environments.
